notes: Frame: model metres, +X east, +Y north. Plan from the NJ 2020 ortho (0.15 m/px, leaf-off), read on gridded sheets and brightness profiles; LiDAR (lidar2017, sparse) for the canopy, tree heights and a few pole returns; hillshade confirms the two platform track faces (x -448 and -440.5 at y -245). OSM is 2-3 m east of the ortho on the rails and is used only for names and the sidewalk/path layout. Platforms: east track face x = -439.6 + 0.115 (y + 236), width 3.3 m, y -234 to -362; west track face x = -448.8 + 0.11 (y + 252), width 3.0 m, y -231 to -308.5. Lot: the north part is bounded by the Normal Ave south curb band (y -235.7 at x -436 to -240.6 at x -416), a lawn island with the station sign and a tree, the entrance drive at x -412 to -402 (crosswalk lines at y -239.5 and -242.6), the east walk and the south walk at y -279/-281; the south part is a single aisle with a stall row along the platform (27 stalls at 2.56 m, lines counted on the ortho) and an inferred east row. The drop-off plaza (concrete, mulch bed, canopy over the platform) is at y -255 to -266. Islands inside the lot carry layer 3.5 and the mulch bed 5.5 so they sit above the asphalt and concrete around them. Not digitised: the east-platform brick paver band (it lies on the north model's platform, which this build does not own), accessible stall hatching (not visible). Added later from the ortho: the crosswalk lines across the entrance drive, the exit stop bar and an aisle arrow. The east canopy was a point of a kind no builder makes; it is now an open building part (shed roof from the LiDAR). The railway corridor is a single straight-ish ballast band 11 m wide with one 300 m bend at y -190; its edges north of Normal Ave are under trees. Points that stand on a platform carry "base": the height of the north model platform top under them, read from the published tiles; mini-high decks are 1.0 m above it (train floor height above a low platform, UNVERIFIED).

lifts.name: Track_level
lifts.evidence: published tiles (north model): ballast top 115.15 m and rail top 115.45 m at the Normal Avenue crossing, platform top 115.33 m; lidar2017 ground there 114.73 m
lifts.unverified: The north model's track and platforms stand about 0.65 m above the LiDAR ground (its ballast and rail were stacked on a ground that already included them). This build raises its own ground by 0.65 m along the track, eased out over 10 m, so the road meets the rails at the crossing and the lot meets the platform. The right fix is to lower the track in the north model; remove this lift when that is done.
